resources.name: Auckland City Mission HomeGround
resources.summary: Auckland City Mission's HomeGround provides free community meals, food parcels, and a route to wider social support.
resources.availabilityNote: The Haeata dining room is walk-in; food parcels and other programs have separate access steps. Check the official help page.
resources.sourceDetail: The official get-help page lists HomeGround's address and its food, housing, health, addiction, and social-work support.

resources.name: Christchurch City Mission Foodbank
resources.summary: Emergency food parcels and a self-serve foodbank, supported by assessment and wider City Mission social services.
services: Hygiene and cleaning essentials when available
resources.availabilityNote: Food collection requires a phone assessment, appointment, photo ID, and proof of address. Do not travel without booking.
resources.sourceDetail: The official foodbank page lists assessment, booking, collection requirements, and the Hereford Street address.

resources.costNote: Free to search; provider rules vary
resources.name: New Zealand Family Services Directory
resources.summary: A New Zealand government search for family and community providers, including basic needs, health, housing, food banks, and crisis support.
resources.availabilityNote: Each provider controls its services and eligibility. Review the listing's update date and confirm directly before travel.
resources.sourceName: New Zealand Ministry of Social Development
resources.sourceDetail: The Ministry describes the directory as a public database connecting people to thousands of family and community service providers.
resources.coverageNote: More than 5,000 local service records, including over 1,300 basic-needs records.

resources.name: Everybody Eats Glen Innes
resources.costNote: Pay what you can, including nothing
resources.hours: Sun, Mon, Wed and Thu, 6:00–8:00 PM
resources.summary: A welcoming restaurant serving a set three-course meal from rescued ingredients on a pay-what-you-can basis, with everyone welcome.
resources.availabilityNote: Menus, closures, and service nights can change. Review the live restaurant page on the day you plan to attend.
resources.sourceDetail: The official restaurant page publishes this address, service nights, hours, and walk-in information.
